ShoreSMP 🌊 | 1.21+ Cross-Play Survival Server

ShoreSMP is a survival multiplayer server focused on community, economy, and PvP. Players can explore a custom world, trade with others, and participate in events.

✨ Features:
• Cross-play support (Java + Bedrock via Geyser)
• Player-driven economy system
• PvP and team gameplay
• Quests and progression
• Regular events and updates
